Using The Newsroom

Roles

Reader

Browses approved articles and newsletters, subscribes to publishers and journalists, and sees matching stories under My feed.

Journalist

Writes articles and newsletters in the Workspace. An article is independent when no publisher is chosen.

Editor

Reviews drafts in their scope (independent content and content from their publishers) and clicks Approve and publish.

Administrator

Manages users, roles and publishers at /admin/.

Publishing workflow

  1. A journalist saves an article for review. Only its author and the responsible editors can open the draft.

  2. An editor approves it. The article becomes public, subscribers are emailed, and the approval is logged to /api/approved/ (see news.services.approve_article()).

  3. If an email or API call fails, the article stays published and the article page offers Retry notifications.

  4. Editing a published article sends it back for review (see news.services.save_article_changes()).

REST API

All API endpoints require authentication with a token (Authorization: Token <key>) or a browser session. List responses are paginated, 20 items per page. See news.api for the endpoints and news.serializers for the fields returned.

Running the project

Setup steps for a virtual environment and for Docker are in the README.md file at the root of the repository.
